subject: Proposal: Tiered uptime bands with stacked on-call & crediting mechanism
messages:
From: Kara Mitchell <kara.mitchell@stellara.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@stellara.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Premium SLA / on-call stacking inquiry

Marcus —

Thanks for taking the time last week. As Stellara scales our inference footprint we need a clearer SLA + premium support packaging for a regulated product line. High level asks: 
- Uptime target options (we're evaluating 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99)
- Explicit crediting methodology and caps for partial outages
- Escalation coverage (24/7 on-call, follow-the-sun, and dedicated escalation engineer)
- 'On-call stacking' — we may run two critical apps and want stacked escalation (first-line + secondary responder)
- Pricing/discounting tied to commit levels (annual vs 24-month)

Can you send a clear, skimmable proposal (table of bands, response times, credit % by severity, and pricing examples) and any legal caveats we should budget for?

Appreciate it — Kara
Kara Mitchell
Head of Platform Ops, Stellara Systems
kara.mitchell@stellara.com
(415) 555-2213
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kara Mitchell <kara.mitchell@stellara.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Premium SLA / on-call stacking inquiry

Hi Kara —

Thanks — attached is our initial proposal and a pricing workbook for quick modeling. Key points up-front: 

Summary table (high level)
- Bronze (99.9%): Response < 4 hours business-hours; credit = 10% monthly invoice for downtime > 1 hour per month
- Silver (99.95%): Response < 2 hours 24/7; credit = 25% for downtime > 30 mins per month
- Gold (99.99%): Response < 30 mins 24/7 + assigned escalation engineer; credit = 50% for downtime > 10 mins per month

On-call stacking: we support a stacked escalation model — secondary responder is assigned and paged concurrently. For stacked coverage we propose a surcharge (listed in the workbook) that covers reserving a secondary engineer + faster triage window.

Discounting and commits: we typically offer: 12-month commit = baseline price; 24-month commit + 20% reserved capacity commitment -> deeper discount band. I'm not publishing an exact percent in this email until I confirm internal approvals, but the workbook includes tiered examples you can tweak (reserved GPUs, committed RPS, monthly committed spend).

Attachments: Redwood_Uptime_Oncall_Proposal_v1.pdf (summary + terms), pricing_breakdown_stellara.xlsx (breakout by commit levels).

Next steps: 
1) Confirm which uptime band you want to price against (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
2) Tell us expected committed spend / reserved capacity to run numbers for a discount band
3) If okay, I will run a quick internal ask for a discount authorization and come back with a formal counteroffer + MSA addendum language

Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week to walk through the workbook.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Proposal for Stellara — pricing ask

Forwarding Stellara's request + my initial draft. Quick internal alignment please.

Context: Stellara wants stacked escalation for two critical apps and wants a clear crediting model + discount for a 12–24 month commit. Estimated initial footprint: 4–6 reserved A100-equivalent instances; ramp to ~12 in 6 months.

Suggested commercial levers (my draft):
- Offer A: 12-month term; 18% discount off list for committed spend >= $180k/mo; includes Silver SLA (99.95) + stacked escalation at 10% surcharge of monthly support fee; 8-hour onboarding included
- Offer B: 24-month term; 22% discount off list for committed spend >= $120k/mo; includes Gold SLA (99.99), assigned escalation engineer, first 3 months of premium on-call waived, unlimited on-call seats for duration 
- Offer C: 12-month term + opt-in reserved capacity (prepaid) = 20% discount if they prepay 6 months and accept Silver SLA

Rishi: ops/engineering viewpoint on feasibility & cost of dedicated escalation engineer + stacking surcharge.
Aditya: margin/discount guardrails — can you confirm approval band?
Laura: include CS/solutions notes on onboarding credits and whether we can absorb first-quarter on-call seats.

--- Internal replies ---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800

Marcus —
We can staff a primary + secondary escalation engineer under Offer B but need a clear runbook/costing for incident overlap. Stacking surcharge of 10% seems low; suggest 15% to cover overlap and on-call overtime. Also: add a clause for 'mass outage' where support moves to incident playbook and costs are mutually agreed.

Rishi
Director, Reliability Engineering

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2027 12:04:00 -0800

Marcus —
I can sign off up to 18% discount with legal & finance pre-approval. For 22% need VP signoff. If they commit to 24 months and we get a minimum committed spend guarantee (the $120k/mo you listed) I can push for 20-21% but need a one-pager ROI for sales leadership.

Aditya Rao
VP, Sales — North America

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2027 13:10:00 -0800

We can absorb the first quarter of premium on-call seats as a competitive concession. Also recommend we include a mutual action plan in the doc (milestones: PO, prepay, onboarding, runbook sign-off).

Laura
Director, Customer Success
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kara Mitchell <kara.mitchell@stellara.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Premium SLA / on-call stacking inquiry — Redwood counteroffer and MAP

Kara —

Thanks for the details and patience while I aligned internally. Below is our counteroffer aimed at balancing Stellara's reliability needs with predictable unit economics. I've attached an updated proposal PDF (v2) and included a DocuSign link for the commercial addendum if you want to move quickly.

Counteroffer (high level)
- Commitment options: 
  • Option 1 — 12 months: 18% discount off list for committed spend >= $180k/month; includes Silver SLA (99.95), stacked escalation enabled (secondary responder paged concurrently), 10% stacking surcharge on the monthly support fee, onboarding credits (8 hours)
  • Option 2 — 24 months: 21% discount off list for committed spend >= $120k/month; includes Gold SLA (99.99), assigned escalation engineer, first 90 days of premium on-call seats waived, stacking surcharge waived for first 3 months
- Credit mechanics: sliding credit anchored to minutes of downtime by band. For Gold: credit = 50% of monthly support fee for >10 minutes downtime. For Silver/Bronze scale proportionally (see attached doc).
- Legal/terms: we'll provide an MSA addendum with clear incident definitions and an exclusion list (scheduled maintenance windows, customer-induced outages).

Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — proposed next steps: 
1) Stellara confirms selected option + expected committed spend (by Tue, 2027-11-23)
2) Redwood builds final SOW & MSA addendum (3 business days after confirmation)
3) Stellara countersigns and submits PO / prepay if selecting Offer C variant
4) Kickoff & runbook sign-off (within 10 business days of executed docs)

If this looks good I can send the commercial addendum via DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/ENVELOPE-45ab and the deal is in HubSpot here: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-78392.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the MAP and answer any redline asks.

Best,
Marcus Lin
